_about: The publish board's one fixed layout (content.krishraja.com). Krish, 2026-10-21: "how do you recommend we standardise and lock in this publish board so the content engine can just feed it? ... For each publish session things move around", and "the rest of the content engine needs to know how to feed it and not be permitted to change random parts of the UI and UX but feed it in the right way consistently. That applies to Claude and to Codex." scripts/post-pack/week_board.py draws every week from this file from layout_from onwards, and its verify() refuses a board whose tabs, steps or slots differ. Changing this file changes the board Krish works in, so it changes only with his recorded words: npm run check:board-layout (CI) holds this file's sha256 and the board's structure in fixtures/week-board/fixed-layout.json and fails until check_board_layout.py --update --approved "Krish, YYYY-MM-DD: <his words>" writes the change with them (Ruling, Krish, 2026-10-21). Docs: docs/PUBLISH_BOARDS.md, 'The fixed layout'.

today._about: Layout A, from the board of the week of 2 November 2026. Krish, 2026-10-29: "yes, go with A and your recommendations and my feedback". It adds a first tab, Today, opened first: the Needs you queue (one row and one button per thing he approves, each a link to it), the stage counts (Idea, Words, Cuts, Publish, Amplify), the Monday to Sunday strip and every post of the week as one equal-height card, off days included, with Liked and Not it in each card's footer and the day opened with its large preview. Drawn by scripts/post-pack/board_today.py; his feedback on the mocks governs it (docs/handovers/2026-10-29-board-phase2.md).

v3._about: Layout v3, from the board of the week of 9 November 2026 (W2.1). Krish, 2026-10-29: "backfill every piece we've done historically, and allow me to add a score out of 10 for narrative quality and production quality". It adds a sixth tab, Archive (every piece from the Launch on 6 October, each with its date, series, title, live links, his two scores and a Scores press), a Scores press on each made day's Publish step, and the recording_sunday rhythm: the board for week W is recorded on Sunday W-8 and goes live on Monday W, so every day's brief and scripts are due on that Sunday. Boards before from keep version 2.

day_steps.label: Publish

rhythm._about: Krish, 2026-10-24: "on a Sunday, Claude will create the publish board and seed the ideas ... On Sunday, we will flesh out the narrative arc ... By Sunday midday, we will have locked the scripts and sent them to teleprompter, and then I'll begin recording", then "Yes, Sunday is my recording day." So every day's brief is agreed on the Sunday morning and every day's scripts are locked by Sunday midday. It replaces the 2026-10-21 rhythm (Monday by Sunday night, Wednesday by Tuesday night, Friday by Thursday night). on: sunday_before is the Sunday that starts the publishing week.

cuts._about: Krish, 2026-10-21: "all videos are generally 90 sec and 5 min. From time to time I might do a special 15 min feature"; asked whether that replaces the weekly deep cut: "Yes, replace it". short and long are on every piece; feature only on a piece listed in config/features.json.

publish_steps._about: The ticks, in the order he posts (docs/AMPLIFICATION.md). The keys are the saved ticks' ids (<day>-<key>): never change a key, or every tick saved under it is orphaned. A label may change. counted: toward the day's 100%. feature_only: shown only on a feature piece.
